coherence_test.decision_rule: staging-coherent if alignment exceeds marginalized random-direction p95 and p_random<0.05
coherence_test.metric: Sigma_marg^{-1/2}; random/shuffled nulls generated in the nuisance-marginalized whitened space

method.baryon_limitation: HSC used HMCode2016 A_bary; pyccl 3.1.2 lacks that parameter, so baryon response is a stamped CCL vanDaalen19 fbar proxy carrying the published A_bary prior width.
method.formula: Sigma_marg = Sigma_data + Sigma_nuis; Sigma_nuis = sum_k sigma_k^2 g_k g_k^T
method.g_k: central finite difference of the HSC cl_ee theory vector at the Dalal+23 MAP
method.uniform_priors: converted to Gaussian-equivalent sigma=(hi-lo)/sqrt(12) for analytic covariance marginalization
